subject: Carr Park Improvement Project
overview: The Commission issued negative determinations of applicability for two redevelopment projects, with the Carr Park renovation receiving specific conditions regarding debris removal and invasive species management.

items.title: Carr Park Improvements RDA
items.summary: Issued a Negative Determination with five conditions for Phase 1 of the Carr Park project, which includes path construction, sports courts, and removal of historic construction debris near isolated wetlands. Conditions require a knotweed management plan, erosion controls, and site monitoring by the conservation agent during excavation and planting.

items.title: 3850 Mystic Valley Parkway RDA
items.summary: Issued a Negative Determination for a Bank of America redevelopment project in the Meadow Glen Mall parking lot as the proposed work is located entirely outside of the bordering land subject to flooding. The project includes a 5,000-square-foot building and will result in a net reduction of approximately 2,000 square feet of impervious surface.

items.title: Administrative Tasks and Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from February 15, 2023, and discussed future meeting schedules regarding the Passover holiday.
